mapper.select: select * from orders where idempotency_key = #{key} limit 1
select * from orders where status = 'PENDING' and create_time < #{cutoff}
select * from orders where status = 'DELIVERED' and delivered_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.update: update orders set status = #{to}, tracking_number = #{tracking}, shipped_at = #{shippedAt}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{from}
update orders set status = #{to}, refund_status = #{refundStatus}, refund_reason = #{reason}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{from}
update orders set status = #{to}, delivered_at = #{deliveredAt}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{from}
update orders set status = #{to}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{from}
update orders set status = #{to}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{from}
mapper.select: select o.* from orders o where o.user_id = #{userId} and o.status in ('DELIVERED','COMPLETED') and exists ( select 1 from order_item oi where oi.order_id = o.id and not exists ( select 1 from review r where r.order_id = o.id and r.product_id = oi.product_id ) ) order by o.create_time desc
